appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.darkMailHelp: Darkens designed emails (light background), keeping images in their true colors.
appearance.languageHelp: Language of the interface and of dates.
appearance.timeFormatHelp: Clock of the times shown. Automatic follows the language.
appearance.weekStartHelp: Where weeks start in the calendar. Automatic follows the language.

accounts.removeConfirm: Remove the account {email} and all its local cache? Messages stay on the server.
accounts.photoTooltip: Reconnect to Google to fetch the account photo
accounts.reconnectTooltip: Renew the authorization given to facteur

accounts.passwordHelp: The password of {user} on the mail server (or an app password). facteur checks it with the server, then keeps it in the system keychain.
accounts.quotaHelp: As the server reports it. With Gmail, the Google account's space, shared with Drive and Photos.
accounts.quotaFull: Nearly full: past the limit, the server turns new mail away.

sync.label: Sync
sync.help: How often facteur reads this account in the background. The Sync button and waking the computer always read everything.
sync.inboxHelp: When live listening is down; otherwise new mail arrives at once.
sync.customHelp: Your folders, and the folder list.
sync.singleHelp: For servers that cut sessions when a mailbox has several (some OVH plans): no instant listening, the inbox is checked at its rhythm.
sync.adviceTitle: Use a single connection for this account?
sync.adviceBody: The server of “{account}” has kept dropping facteur's connections for more than twenty minutes. Some offers (such as OVH's MX Plan included with a web hosting) accept only one connection at a time per mailbox.
sync.adviceEffect: With a single connection, the inbox is checked every minute instead of being listened to live. You can change it in the account's settings, sync rhythm.

screener.label: Screen new senders
screener.help: Their first message waits in “New senders” until you accept it. People you wrote to, or who already wrote to you, are never held.
screener.offConfirm: {n} message is waiting in “New senders”: it will go back to the inbox. | {n} messages are waiting in “New senders”: they will go back to the inbox.
screener.search: Search an address or a domain
screener.empty: Your decisions are listed here as you accept or screen out senders.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.helpGoogle: The calendars of your Google account, read only.
calendar.helpCaldav: This account's CalDAV calendars, read only.
calendar.helpMicrosoft: The Outlook calendars of your Microsoft account, read only.
calendar.caldavHint: Leave it empty for facteur to find it from your address.
calendar.ignored: Not used: this account stays out of the calendar.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.helpGoogle: Google contacts suggest names and addresses as you write.
contacts.helpMicrosoft: Outlook contacts suggest names and addresses as you write.
contacts.helpCarddav: The account's CardDAV address book suggests names and addresses as you write.

mail.title: Notifications and mail
mail.notificationsHelp: “People” ignores newsletters, automated notifications and mailing lists.
mail.notifyDurationHelp: How long a notification stays on screen. “Windows” follows the system setting (a few seconds, changed in Accessibility › Visual effects).
mail.undoSendHelp: The message waits this long before leaving: “Undo” reopens it.
mail.rulesHelp: File, mark as read or pin new messages automatically.
mail.isDefault: facteur opens “mailto:” links across the whole system.
mail.senderLogosHelp: Brand logos (Airbnb, GitHub…) instead of initials. Each logo is requested once per domain, from the brand's own website.
mail.trustedHelp: For these domains (or addresses), images load as soon as the message opens, unless it is deemed untrustworthy.
mail.blockedEmpty: None. Use “Block” from a conversation's ⋯ menu.
mail.smartInboxHelp: Sorts inboxes into People, Notifications and Newsletters. System notifications only cover people.
mail.folderCountsHelp: Next to each folder: what is unread, or everything in it.
mail.countUnitHelp: Conversations, as the list shows them (“+”: the server holds more, not in facteur yet), or messages, as the server counts them.
mail.description: What alerts you, what gets sorted, what gets shown.
mail.threadOrderHelp: Oldest at the top, or newest at the top. Older read messages stay folded, and the conversation opens on the first unread one.
mail.backgroundListeningHelp: Keeps the connection to your mailboxes open while facteur is in the background, so new mail arrives right away. A discreet notification stays visible; uses a little more battery.
mail.notifyNewSendersHelp: When someone writes to you for the first time. Otherwise, their message waits quietly in “New senders”.
mail.eventRemindersHelp: A notification before an event of your calendars, at the reminders it has in Google, Outlook or your CalDAV calendar.
mail.templatesHelp: Texts to insert while writing, and quick replies under messages.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: A full copy of every message in every folder on this computer, one .eml file per message (Maildir format). Only new messages are downloaded, and nothing is ever deleted from the backup, even if the message disappears from the server.
backup.autoHelp: When facteur starts, then every hour, accounts not backed up in the last 24 hours are backed up.
backup.summary: No account backed up | {n} account backed up | {n} accounts backed up

setup.intro: Add your first mail account (IMAP/SMTP). The password is kept in the system keychain.

account.passwordHint: With iCloud, Yahoo or Fastmail: an app password, not the account's own.
account.name: Display name
account.notFound: No settings found for this domain, enter them below.
account.isMicrosoft: Is this a Microsoft account (Outlook, Hotmail)?
account.oauthNote: {provider} does not accept passwords in apps: you sign in through your browser, and facteur only keeps a token in the system keychain.
account.unencryptedHelp: Your password and messages will travel over the network in clear text. Only use this for a test server on this computer.

rules.title: Rules
rules.notBulk: it is not a bulk mailing
rules.needCondition: Add at least one condition with a value.
rules.nothingProcessed: No matching messages in the inbox
rules.intro: Rules apply to new messages arriving in the inbox, in the order below. Messages they file away or mark as read do not trigger a notification.
rules.empty: No rules yet. For example: everything from {'@'}irs.gov goes to “Taxes”.
rules.name: Name

preview.title: Rule preview
preview.messages: no matching messages | matching message | matching messages
preview.none: No inbox message matches yet: the rule will apply to incoming ones.
preview.apply: Apply to {n} message | Apply to {n} messages

rules.runDisabled: This rule is turned off: turn it on to apply it to the messages in the inbox.

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.remindDays: reminder after {n} days | reminder after {n} day | reminder after {n} days
outbox.empty: No messages waiting to be sent.
outbox.note: Scheduled messages are sent from this computer: if facteur is closed at the scheduled time, they go out the next time it starts.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: A template is inserted at the cursor, from the “Templates” button while writing. Marked as a quick reply, it also shows under the latest message of a conversation: one click opens the reply with its text.
templates.name: Name
templates.textPlaceholder: Hello, thank you for your message…
templates.quickHelp: Shown under the latest message of a conversation: one click opens the reply with this text.

ai.keywords: artificial intelligence AI model summary summarize appointment Qwen GGUF
ai.intro: Sum up a thread, find an appointment in a message. Off until you turn it on.
ai.title: AI on this computer
ai.help: A language model running on your computer, to sum up threads and make an event from a message.
ai.unavailable: This build of facteur has no local AI.
ai.private: Everything stays on this computer: no message and no text is sent to a server. Only the model's file is downloaded, once.
ai.slowHere: Slow on this computer ({n} GB of memory advised)
ai.sourceHelp: The models offered (Qwen 3.5, Apache 2.0 license) are downloaded from Hugging Face and checked. A GGUF file of your own was not tested with facteur: results may vary.
ai.offConfirm: The model is deleted from the computer ({size} freed). You can download it again.
ai.offConfirmFile: facteur will no longer use your file (it stays where it is).

graphics.title: Graphics card
graphics.help: The work goes through the graphics card when the computer has one, faster than on the processor alone. Turn it off if the AI gets slower or unstable.
graphics.using: In use: {card}. Turn it off if the AI gets slower or unstable.
graphics.off: Off: the AI uses the processor only.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.help: Dictate your messages: a microphone button in the composer. Your voice is transcribed on this computer ({size} model).
dictation.offConfirm: The dictation model is deleted from the computer ({size} freed).
